Skill

You might say

I have to teach the AI the same process every time. Can it remember how to do this task?

A specialized workflow and instruction package organized in a standard directory, with SKILL.md as the entry point for agents to execute on demand.·A Skill can include instructions, scripts, references, and templates. When a task matches it, an agent reads those materials and follows the documented method.
Know first
AI AgentSystem Prompt
Agent SkillSKILL.md
What is inside a Skill?
Current taskPrepare a video and complete its pre-publish checkRead the overview
video-publisher/a Skill folder
AgentRead entry
Read the overviewSKILL.md
This Skill: help publish a videoWhen to use it: when preparing to publish or checking a videoHow: read the rules → check → produce the result

SKILL.md explains what the Skill does, when to use it, and how to complete the task.

A Skill is a folder with SKILL.md as its entry point; add other files when the task needs them.

02 · Install and use

How to install a Skill

Send the repository address and the Skill path to your agent so it can download, install, and check it.

YouSend these two lines to your agent
https://github.com/oil-oil/vibe-hub-skill
Install the skills/vibehub Skill from this repository.
→
Installedskills/vibehub/Your agent can use it now

A Skill can also come from: GitHub, SkillHub, A local folder shared by someone else

How to use it after installationTell your agent what you want to do

You can name the Skill directly or describe the task and let the agent decide whether it applies.

YouFor example
Use VibeHub to help me understand Git Branch.

Different agents can store Skills in different places. Ask the current agent to confirm its location during installation.

03 · Purpose

What a Skill does

A Skill mainly solves two problems: it preserves a repeatable method and gives the agent the knowledge and files it needs.

A repeatable weekly-report workflow
  1. Collect records
  2. Organize them using the template
  3. Check and deliver
Skill
Team referencesWriting guide.mdcheck-report.mjsWeekly report template.pptx
1Standardize a workflowUse the same steps each time2Provide new knowledgeGive the agent information it did not have
04 · Create

How to create a Skill

Do not start from a blank format. Ask Skill Creator to generate a first version.

YouTell your agent this
Use Skill Creator to create a Video Publishing Skill. Ask what problem it should solve first, then generate a first version.
→
video-publisher/SKILL.mdscripts/references/
  1. 1

    Tell the AI what problem the Skill should solve

  2. 2

    Ask Skill Creator for a first version

  3. 3

    Test it on real work, then improve it

05 · Test

How to test a Skill

Give the same task to an agent with the Skill and to one without it, then compare the results directly.

Same model · same input · same taskTurn 12 project updates into a weekly report
Without a Skill

Give the task and raw updates only; let the agent choose its own method.

Results vary more
With the Skill loaded

Give the same task and updates, and tell the agent to use the weekly-report Skill.

Results are easier to reproduce
ResultProcessConsistencyCost

If the platform supports subagents, test in parallel. Otherwise, use two separate conversations.

06 · Best practices

Skill best practices

Skills are read by AI, so keep them short, clear, and executable.

SKILL.md
name: video-publisherdescription: Publish videos and check platform requirements. Use when someone is preparing to publish, checking dimensions, or making a cover image.Complete the checks, generation, and pre-publish confirmation in order.

Write a clear description：State what the Skill does and what tasks should use it.

What people often confuse

A Skill provides a method and related files; it does not automatically grant access to accounts, platforms, or external systems.

You can say this to an AI Agent
